claims: s(k^2 - 5) = k for every integer k >= 7 (README.md, paper/k2m5.pdf): k = 7, 8 and 9 are the s(44) = 7, s(59) = 8 and s(76) = 9 certificates of the authors, Hiroaki Hosono and Benjamin Greff, and every k >= 10 is one family of measures mu_k on [0,k]^2, a corner module in each corner, a period-1 wall pattern of depth 4 along each side and Lebesgue measure on [19/5, k - 19/5]^2, of total mass k^2 - 4D with D = 1340566927759/10^12 > 5/4 (paper Lemma 6), so below k^2 - 5.

Locality (paper Lemma 7) reduces every k >= 10 to one board, mu_11 = certificate/sol_exact_box11.txt (SHA-256 d259fed5c9d5eb02c6fed85f5d1070e86d48f5717305f9e056c9a88adbd12099), 13,244 weighted segments on the 1/10 grid with masses w/(2*10^12) and Lebesgue measure on [19/5, 36/5]^2, in Evan Daniel's mixed format; the Lean 4 development lean/K2m5 states k2m5_of_valid11 : Valid11 -> forall k >= 10, minSide (k^2 - 5) = k, built by the authors on 12 November 2026 against Daniel's Lean library at 659ee62 with the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound (lean/build.log).

Validity of mu_11 (paper Theorem 10): theta = 0 by Daniel's Lemma Z at 10,000 limit corners, an exact axis check at 7,717 corners and zmx2 cert0 on 2,500 roots; 12,024 of 12,100 D4 roots by zmx2 cert --d4 --first-order --depth 40 --node-cap 20000000 in 55 columns (verification/logs/zmx2_box11/, about 45,366 CPU-seconds recorded); root 9632, whose 6,850 zmx2-uncertified boxes lie in one qx2_zm.py root that qx2_zm.py at depth 18 leaves with 83 uncertified boxes, none meeting them (verification/r9632/check_9632.py); and the 75 tight-tile roots by the Tight-Tile Lemma (tight_tile/, paper section 6 and paper/tight_tile_report.pdf), 308 jobs at u0 = 1/4000 and 15 at 1/2000, about 2.75 million cells, with all 1,255,023 boxes zmx2 leaves there inside the certified region (tight_tile/cov_check.py, COVERAGE-OK).

Controls (docs/CHECKING.md): zmx2 refuses every segment mass scaled by 999/1000 and 993/1000 at root (15, 36), which it certifies for the real board; qx2_zm.py at root 9632 with masses scaled by 999/1000 leaves 87 boxes, 3 meeting zmx2's, so check_9632.py says NOT-CLOSED; the Tight-Tile checker refuses masses times 0.99, the line x = 2 lowered by 1% and one moved segment with the same theta = 0 limits and a smaller first-order growth (tight_tile/ctl_rise.txt, a true violation of mass 1 - 1.34e-7); locality_check.py refuses a one-weight mutation of mu_12.

verification/verify.sh (fast) re-checks the certificate hashes, the exact bookkeeping, locality on built boards k = 10, 12, 13 and 20, and exact audits of the recorded zmx2 sweep, root 9632 and every tight-tile job and the coverage; --full re-runs zmx2 and the tight-tile jobs (hours for zmx2, CPU-days for the tight tiles). The authors report a separate agent's adversarial review of the Tight-Tile proof and code (docs/CHECKING.md) and no review by outside mathematicians; the paper is not peer reviewed.
